prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical outdoor lifestyle portrait of one original approved adult woman with long dark wind-swept hair, tanned complexion, full defined lips, dark eyes, realistic pores and natural sunlit skin. She wears a metallic gold triangle bikini with thin spaghetti straps and matching side-tie bottoms, a long gold necklace with cross-like accents and pearl drop earrings. Use a subject-centered medium close-up from a low-angle upward-looking perspective. She leans slightly forward toward the camera, head tilted slightly back and to her right, looks directly into the lens with a neutral confident expression, and extends both arms downward toward the lower corners as if holding or bracing the camera. Set the scene outdoors beside a white wooden slatted structure, textured light stone or stucco wall and dry shrub beneath a clear vibrant blue sky. Use hard direct natural sunlight from overhead/front, realistic highlights on skin and metallic fabric, defined shadows beneath the jaw and necklace, crisp natural pores, a worm's-eye smartphone perspective without wide-angle distortion, and a bold sunlit summer atmosphere.
